GETTING STARTED

1. Create your password. Open this link:
   https://app.afiax.africa/setpassword/9f1c2b7e-0d5a-4c1b-8a3e-2f6d7c8b9a01/3b9e1f0c7a2d4e6f
   Choose at least 8 characters. Afiax won't accept a password that has
   appeared in a known data leak.

2. Sign in at https://app.afiax.africa/signin with your email address, akinyi.otieno@example.co.ke,
   and your new password.

3. Set up two-step sign-in. Afiax will show you a code to scan with an
   authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator or
   Microsoft Authenticator. After that, each time you sign in you'll also
   type the 6-digit number the app shows.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

You'll see Nairobi West Clinic's workspace. What you can see and change depends on your role, which Jane Wanjiku set. If something you need is missing, ask them to change your access.

The password link works once. If it has already been used, or you lose this email, choose "Forgot password" on the sign-in page and Afiax will send you a new link.
